messages.subject: Performance Tests
parts:
The performance tests are similarly fragile and hard to use
(but that’s okay, I guess?). Trying to run the tests in a clean
pull gives

>./runTests.py src/test/performance/
------------------------------------------------------------
make test/performance//logistic
src/test/performance//logistic_test.cpp:47:10: fatal error: 'test/test-models/performance/logistic.hpp' file not found

For whatever reason the model in src/test/test-models/performance
isn’t being built by the test.

But also everything is being tested against 2.5.0 How does
this get updated? What is the procedure for getting new
values and updating the version?
